text:
dana: Quick sweep — RC cutoff in ~2.5h. Can we do a fast pipeline sanity + flaky triage? Noticed 2 failures in the last build: integration/payment-timeout (2x) and unit/kvcache-serialize (flaky). Who can own quick root-cause or a temporary skip?
kevin: On it. Re-triggering the broken pipeline now. If you need to re-run a specific job, run `./scripts/ci retry --build 98765` or via Buildkite: `bk restart 98765`.
lina: FYI I have a version-bump PR open (#4215) — waiting on final changelog entry. If tests go green I'll merge.
morgan: @lina can you add a changelog note for the kvcache behavior? we should call out the cache-key determinism change.
sre-ops: Investigating the integration timeout — saw high CPU on the runner around the job window. Reproducing a few runs against the same runner now.
ci-bot: ci-bot: Build 98765 retriggered by kevin — 3 jobs queued.
kevin: kvcache-serialize flake looks like nondet ordering; adding a tiny ordering assertion and a 10ms sleep in the test made it stable locally. If it repros in CI I'll open a hotfix PR.
harper: If we end up skipping a test for the cut, prefer a targeted skip with an issue link + short todo. Can someone create that PR and tag @release so it's tracked?
lina: I'll add the changelog line and open the skip PR if it still fails after one more run.
sre-ops: Update: rerun passed integration; unit/kvcache still flaking (1/3). Continuing to triage — if it stays flaky we'll proceed with the release and backfill a quick patch.
dana: :thumbsup: Plan: wait 30m for one more run. If kvcache fails >1/3, create a targeted skip PR and proceed with version bump + changelog merge. Ping @release when PRs are ready.
